# vcp_server_backup_storages (Data Source)

Fetches the backup storages a server's copies can be kept in, with their price, and the partner's limits a `vcp_server_backup` schedule has to fit into. The list is the one the panel offers in the server's backup settings: it depends on the server's location and on the project's tariff, so it is read per server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the backup storages a server's copies can be kept in, and the limits a
# schedule has to fit into.
data "vcp_server_backup_storages" "example" {
  server_id = vcp_server.example.id
}

# The cheapest storage, for the rules of vcp_server_backup.
output "cheapest_backup_storage_id" {
  value = try([for s in data.vcp_server_backup_storages.example.storages : s.id if s.price_per_gb == min(data.vcp_server_backup_storages.example.storages[*].price_per_gb...)][0], null)
}

# How many daily copies the partner allows.
output "max_daily_copies" {
  value = try(data.vcp_server_backup_storages.example.limits.daily.max_keep, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server whose backup storages are listed.

### Read-Only

- `limits` (Attributes) The partner's limits of the backup schedule. Null when the API returns none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `storages` (Attributes List) The storages available to the server, in the order the API lists them. `id` is what a rule of `vcp_server_backup` takes as `backup_storage_id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storages))

<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `daily` (Attributes) Limits of the `daily` rule of `vcp_server_backup`. Null when the partner sets none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits--daily))
- `monthly` (Attributes) Limits of the `monthly` rule of `vcp_server_backup`. Null when the partner sets none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits--monthly))
- `schedule_window_from_hour` (Number) The earliest `hour` a schedule may start copies at.
- `schedule_window_to_hour` (Number) The latest `hour` a schedule may start copies at.
- `weekly` (Attributes) Limits of the `weekly` rule of `vcp_server_backup`. Null when the partner sets none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits--weekly))

<a id="nestedatt--limits--daily"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits.daily`

Read-Only:

- `default_keep` (Number) The `keep` the panel offers for the rule by default.
- `max_keep` (Number) The largest `keep` the rule accepts.


<a id="nestedatt--limits--monthly"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits.monthly`

Read-Only:

- `default_keep` (Number) The `keep` the panel offers for the rule by default.
- `max_keep` (Number) The largest `keep` the rule accepts.


<a id="nestedatt--limits--weekly"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits.weekly`

Read-Only:

- `default_keep` (Number) The `keep` the panel offers for the rule by default.
- `max_keep` (Number) The largest `keep` the rule accepts.



<a id="nestedatt--storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storages`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the storage. Null when it has none.
- `id` (Number) ID of the storage.
- `location_id` (String) ID of the location the storage is in.
- `name` (String) Name of the storage.
- `price_per_gb` (Number) Price of keeping one gigabyte of copies, in the project's tariff.
- `restore_location_ids` (List of String) IDs of the locations a copy from this storage can be restored into as a new server.
- `sort_order` (Number) Position of the storage in the panel's list.
